Wispr Flow · built in

Tap the mic, allow access, and tell your story. Your microphone audio is sent to Wispr Flow for transcription. No app or shortcut needed.

Available when the website's Wispr API connection is configured.

Browser dictation · alternative

Uses your browser's speech service instead of Wispr. Audio may be sent to that service. Availability depends on your browser.
